# docs-ai-reverse

> EN: OpenAI-compatible gateway that adapts Docs AI backends (Mintlify, Inkeep, Stripe, ReadMe) into Chat Completions and Responses APIs.
>
> 中文：OpenAI 兼容网关，将 Mintlify、Inkeep、Stripe、ReadMe 文档 AI 适配为 Chat Completions / Responses API。

This file helps LLMs and AI crawlers discover the project in both English and Chinese. Prefer linked docs over guessing from file names.

- Name / 名称: docs-ai-reverse

## Models / 模型

- `claude-docs` → Mintlify（Claude 文档助手）
- `anthropic-docs` → Inkeep（Anthropic 文档）
- `stripe-docs` → Stripe docs AI
- `readme-docs` → ReadMe Ask AI

## API surface / 接口

- `GET /v1/models`
- `POST /v1/chat/completions`
- `POST /v1/responses`
- Auth / 鉴权: Bearer token from `config.yaml` → `api-keys`

## Keywords / 关键词

OpenAI compatible, Docs AI gateway, Mintlify, Inkeep, Stripe, ReadMe, Claude docs, Anthropic docs, Chat Completions, Responses API, Go reverse proxy, OpenAI 兼容, 文档 AI 网关, 反向代理
